messages:
kevin: FYI — discovered a regression in the EU embeddings path causing ~1% 503s for short requests. Patch ready, need expedited deploy in the 02:00-03:00 UTC change window. Requesting fast approvals from ops + dev lead.

deploy-bot: build 2026.03.21-hotfix-eu-emb-42 ready for rollout. Automated smoke tests: PASS (local), queue: 2. To proceed, need 2 approvals via this thread.

marta: pinging @sre-oncall for readiness, any current maintenance going on in eu1?

sre-oncall (lucy): eu1 is green; no other deploys scheduled. I'll monitor post-deploy.

kevin: short release note below — will run canary 5% for 10m then 25 -> 100 if stable. Rollback criteria: >0.5% error rate or p95 latency regressed >150ms over baseline for 5m.

kevin: ```Release note: hotfix - embeddings path (eu1) fixed NPE during short input handling. Affects only short payloads (<64 tokens). No schema changes.```

maria: I'm +1 for expedited, agree with rollback criteria. can we pin the prior model image as fallback?

dev-lead (sanjay): need one more +1 from infra/ops. Also confirm that canary traffic split can be forced to 0 quickly.

marta: infra confirmed: canary switchback available, and we have image: rwd-inference/v1.13.7 as pinned fallback.

kevin: tagging approvals: @maria +1, @sanjay pending. @lucy can you give official ops +1?

sre-oncall (lucy): ops +1. I'll stay on the thread and run the post-deploy checklist.

deploy-bot: approval-record: approvals=[maria, lucy]. Pending: dev-lead (sanjay). Will hold in escrow for 2 minutes for final sign-off or auto-continue on two approvals? Reply with `hold` to keep escrow.

kevin: we need to roll now, will auto-continue after escrow window.

sre-oncall (lucy): lucy: starting canary at 02:05 UTC -> 5% traffic. Observing metrics.

deploy-bot: canary started: 5% at 02:05:12. Tracking error_rate, p95_latency, token_throughput.

maria: watching dashboards — error_rate trending down already. p95 looks steady.

sre-oncall (lucy): halfway through 10m canary: error_rate 0.12% (baseline 0.9%), p95 +10ms. All good.

dev-lead (sanjay): sanjay: +1. go to 25% then full if no regressions.

deploy-bot: escalating to 25% at 02:16:40.

sre-oncall (lucy): 25% holding; no regressions at 25m check. Proceed to 100%.

deploy-bot: rollout to 100% complete at 02:22:05. Post-deploy healthcheck: PASS.

kevin: thanks everyone. I'll update release notes and close the RFC. Follow-up: schedule a short retro tomorrow — also adding a QA prompt set to catch this short-input edge case in the regression suite. :thumbsup:

marta: adding release note entry to docs and tagging customer-success for heads-up to impacted accounts.

sre-oncall (lucy): leaving a quick runbook snippet in the incident playbooks repo ops-channel: if error_rate >0.5% -> immediately flip canary to 0 and trigger image pin rollback to rwd-inference/v1.13.7.

kevin: thread locked; thanks for the quick approvals. :party_parrot:
